functionDeclarations.name: schedule
functionDeclarations.description: Schedule a one-shot timer (DurationSeconds) or a recurring cron job (CronExpression) that notifies you via Prompt. This tool call runs as a background task and returns immediately; end your turn (call no more tools) to wait for notifications. A timer with a TimerCondition is cancelled early by a matching message, which is itself your wakeup. Set IsDaemon only for a cron that should keep firing after the current task is done. Use the manage_task tool to cancel active schedules, and never use a shell sleep command as a timer.

CronExpression.description: Standard 5-field cron expression for a recurring schedule (e.g. '*/5 * * * *' for every 5 minutes). Mutually exclusive with DurationSeconds.

DurationSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for a one-shot timer. Mutually exclusive with CronExpression.

IsDaemon.description: Cron only. Set true only for an independent standing job that should keep firing after the current task is done.

MaxIterations.description: Cron only. Maximum number of triggers before the schedule stops; defaults to unlimited.

Prompt.description: Message sent to you as a high-priority notification when the timer fires or the cron triggers.

TimerCondition.description: Timer only. Cancels the timer early when a matching message arrives: 'never' (default), 'any' (any message), or a sender ID (a message from that subagent or background task).
